tool_signatures.name: analyze_ai_stack
tool_signatures.description: Automated observations about a set of AI tools (2-40 GateOnAI tool slugs): tools not currently listed, category overlaps and data connections found in GateOnAI's IO-compatibility graph.

tool_signatures.name: build_workflow_board
tool_signatures.description: Turn a goal described in plain language into a GateOnAI Workbench board: tools from the GateOnAI catalog, connected step by step when they form a workflow. Returns a share link that contains the board; nothing is stored.

tool_signatures.name: compare_ai_tools
tool_signatures.description: Compare two or three AI tools head-to-head.

tool_signatures.name: find_ai_pipeline
tool_signatures.description: Find a computed sequence of AI tools from one content type to another (e.g. audio to a blog post), from automatically assigned input/output tags (not tested).

tool_signatures.name: find_similar_by_philosophy
tool_signatures.description: Find AI tools that are conceptually or philosophically similar to a given tool - based on semantic embedding similarity of each tool's name and tagline (MiniLM), not just shared category.

tool_signatures.name: get_ai_workflow
tool_signatures.description: Generate a step-by-step AI workflow for any profession, role, or business task.

tool_signatures.name: get_compatible_tools
tool_signatures.description: Find AI tools that may connect with a given tool, computed from automatically assigned input/output tags (not tested).

tool_signatures.name: get_eu_gdpr_tools
tool_signatures.description: Find AI tools whose provider pages refer to the GDPR or state EU hosting.

tool_signatures.name: get_market_landscape
tool_signatures.description: A computed statistical snapshot of one GateOnAI category: live tool count, GateOnAI Score distribution (average/median/min/max) and current top-scoring tools.

tool_signatures.name: get_prompts_for_profession
tool_signatures.description: Get ready-to-use AI prompts for a specific profession from GateOnAI's library of thousands of prompts across dozens of professions.

tool_signatures.name: get_site_stats
tool_signatures.description: Get current live statistics about the GateOnAI platform including total listed tools, categories, tool compatibility connections, and prompt library size.

tool_signatures.name: get_tool_details
tool_signatures.description: Get comprehensive details about a specific AI tool by its URL slug.

tool_signatures.name: get_trending_tools
tool_signatures.description: Get the currently trending AI tools on GateOnAI based on real user engagement data.

tool_signatures.name: get_workflow_template
tool_signatures.description: Get one of GateOnAI's thousands of pre-built, ready-made AI workflows for a specific profession - a deterministic, ordered sequence of steps each matched to a listed tool by category and GateOnAI Score, regenerated live fr

tool_signatures.name: match_prompt_to_task
tool_signatures.description: Find the existing prompts that best match a free-text task description (BM25 full-text search).

tool_signatures.name: search_ai_tools
tool_signatures.description: Search GateOnAI's database of thousands of listed AI tools.

tool_signatures.name: whats_new
tool_signatures.description: See AI tools recently added to GateOnAI, based on the date each tool was added.
